name: Akutoku Toshi Ryoshuu no Onna Shoukin Kasegi
original_name: 悪徳都市 虜囚の女賞金稼ぎ
source:
In this game you're catching resolute, skilled female bounty-hunters in your traps and give them hands-on sexual training.

The girls are fully voice acted and their voice work includes a plethora of intense vulgarities and sounds. It features strong-willed tomboys who aren't afraid to put their courage on display, but also let out moans from the bottom of their soul.

Note: This game contains futanari images. 
Those who feel bothered by this, proceed with caution.

[Translated from the [url=http://heisen.blog96.fc2.com/blog-entry-182.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你要在陷阱中捕捉坚决、熟练的女性赏金猎人，并对她们进行实际的性训练。

女孩们都是完全配音的，她们的配音工作包括大量强烈的粗俗和声音。它的特点是意志坚强的假小子，他们不害怕展示自己的勇气，但也从灵魂深处发出呻吟。

注意：该游戏包含futanari图像。
那些对此感到困扰的人，请谨慎行事。
